officialTitle: Adjuvant atezolizumab after adjuvant chemotherapy in resected stage IB-IIIA non-small-cell lung cancer (IMpower010): a randomised, multicentre, open-label, phase 3 trial

design.sampleSizeSourceQuote: 1005 patients were eligible for randomisation to atezolizumab (n=507) or best supportive care (n=498)
primaryEndpoints: Investigator-assessed DFS (hierarchical: stage II–IIIA PD-L1 TC ≥1%, all stage II–IIIA, ITT stage IB–IIIA)
design.notes: Randomisation after completion of adjuvant platinum-based chemotherapy; PD-L1 by SP263 assay.

clinicalQuestion: Does adjuvant atezolizumab after adjuvant platinum chemotherapy improve DFS in resected stage IB–IIIA NSCLC?

pico.population: Completely resected stage IB to IIIA NSCLC after adjuvant platinum-based chemotherapy
pico.intervention: Atezolizumab 1200 mg every 21 days for 16 cycles or 1 year
pico.outcomes: Primary: hierarchical DFS. Secondary: OS, safety

arms.label: Atezolizumab
arms.dosing: 1200 mg every 21 days for 16 cycles or 1 year
arms.doseSourceQuote: atezolizumab (1200 mg every 21 days; for 16 cycles or 1 year)

arms.label: Best supportive care
arms.regimen: Observation and regular scans after adjuvant platinum-based chemotherapy

publications.title: Adjuvant atezolizumab after adjuvant chemotherapy in resected stage IB-IIIA non-small-cell lung cancer (IMpower010): a randomised, multicentre, open-label, phase 3 trial.
publications.label: Primary DFS interim analysis

publications.title: Overall survival with adjuvant atezolizumab after chemotherapy in resected stage II-IIIA non-small-cell lung cancer (IMpower010): a randomised, multicentre, open-label, phase III trial.
publications.label: First interim OS analysis

outcomes.sourceQuote: atezolizumab treatment improved disease-free survival compared with best supportive care in patients in the stage II-IIIA population whose tumours expressed PD-L1 on 1% or more of tumour cells (HR 0·66; 95% CI 0·50-0·88; p=0·0039)
and in all patients in the stage II-IIIA population (0·79; 0·64-0·96; p=0·020)
In the ITT population, HR for disease-free survival was 0·81 (0·67-0·99; p=0·040).
The median OS in the ITT population was not estimable; the stratified hazard ratio (HR) was 0.995 [95% confidence interval (CI) 0.78-1.28].
0.71 (0.49-1.03) in the stage II-IIIA PD-L1 tumour cell (TC) ≥1% (n = 476)
0.43 (95% CI 0.24-0.78) in the stage II-IIIA PD-L1 TC ≥50% (n = 229) populations

safety.description: Atezolizumab-related grade 3–4 adverse events (and grade 5 events)
safety.sourceQuote: Atezolizumab-related grade 3 and 4 adverse events occurred in 53 (11%) of 495 patients and grade 5 events in four patients (1%).

strengths: Large randomised phase III with hierarchical testing
limitations: Open-label with best supportive care control
Benefit concentrated in PD-L1-positive (especially high-expressing) subgroups; OS immature in ITT at first interim
Randomisation after chemotherapy excludes patients not fit for adjuvant chemotherapy

clinicalImplications.text: Supports adjuvant atezolizumab after platinum chemotherapy for resected stage II–IIIA NSCLC with PD-L1 expression, with the strongest signal in tumours with high PD-L1 expression; driver status should be checked first.

tumourBoardPearl.text: IMpower010's benefit tracks PD-L1: DFS was positive in PD-L1 ≥1% stage II–IIIA, and the exploratory OS signal was driven by PD-L1 ≥50%.

curation.notes: All numbers transcribed from the PubMed abstracts of PMIDs 34555333 (primary DFS) and 37467930 (first interim OS).
